Use the attached images only as reference as described: the first attachment is always the style reference for palette and brushwork; later attachments are the approved designs to keep. Swatches: Redraw of the attached reference sheet to the current spec: keep exactly the same swatches, their order and names. Title at the top: "Rootwarden kit: materials".
